## Checklist

- [ ] Ran it myself (and on a real iPhone + Android if the pad changed)

- [ ] Protocol unchanged, or `PROTOCOL_VERSION` bumped and ARCHITECTURE.md updated

- [ ] No secrets, no `node_modules`, no raw art sources
